title: Overriding Properties and Methods
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of overriding properties and methods using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates overriding properties and methods.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Overriding Properties and Methods** as part of **Inheritance, Interfaces, and Polymorphism**. Apply overriding properties and methods by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—The override Keyword, Overriding Properties, Preventing Further Overrides—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
